title: Safety Compliance Officer.
officialText:
In addition to any other remedies or penalties authorized by law, the commissioner in his or
her discretion may require the presence of a SCO at any permitted site that has received immediately hazardous violations that the
commissioner determines adversely affect public safety and require the presence of a SCO to protect public safety. In any circumstance
where a SCO is required, the commissioner shall state in writing the circumstances necessitating the SCO, and the duration of the
compliance monitoring and/or conditions that must be satisfied prior to the termination of the compliance monitoring.
